readout_other: voltage-sensitive dye and GCaMP6f wide-field imaging; GFAP immunostaining; Evans blue extravasation
direction_notes: FUS preceding forelimb stimulation shortened onset latency by 3.0 ms at 0.69 W/cm2 (not at 3.5 W/cm2) and increased solidity and circularity of the Ca2+ response; FUS alone evoked no response.
safety_notes: No differential GFAP expression 24 h after sonication and no Evans blue extravasation at the neuromodulation intensity.

exposures.label: FUS to mouse forelimb S1, 510 kHz

target.label: forelimb's representation on primary somatosensory cortex

device.model: custom 16-element ring array (modified H-205B), TPO-106 driver

timing.protocol_description: A 1 s burst of pulsed FUS (500 us pulses at 510 kHz, 1 kHz repetition rate) ending 200 ms before electrical forelimb stimulation and optical recording of 0.5 s; trials separated by 30 s. Pressure of 0.17 MPa given for the 0.69 W/cm2 condition.
